request: Reduce whitespace and use large edge-to-edge website layouts
title: Full-width storefront composition
purpose: Use the full viewport for product imagery and reduce excess spacing

files.purpose: Increase product scale and remove unused outer space from the homepage.
files.previous_behavior: Cabinet and selection panel capped at 1440px inside 4% gutters; pies capped at 210px height; large section and header spacing.
files.new_behavior: Cabinet spans viewport at every checked width; pie height scales with cabinet; reduced header/title spacing; homepage catalog and editorial/store imagery extend edge to edge while text retains small readable insets.
files.data_impact: None: CSS only; no data reads, writes or schema changes.
files.access_control_impact: None: presentation changes do not affect permissions.
risks: Large-screen cabinet height scales with width; text and controls keep inner padding.
files.rollback: Revert this commit to restore the former width constraints and spacing; no data migration needed.

production_safety.operational_data: No production data accessed or changed.
external_side_effects: No deployment or external writes. Browser verification may load existing fonts.

verification.evidence: Next production compilation, typecheck and 16 static pages succeeded.
10 desktop/mobile tests passed in 18.5 seconds, including hover/cart/checkout/store flows.
390/1440/1920px cabinet width equals viewport width; no horizontal overflow.

verification.command: Visual review of full-width-1440.png and home-desktop.png
verification.evidence: Edge-to-edge cabinet, enlarged pies, collection images, story photo and store photo render without clipping.

residual_risks: Native Safari and physical devices not tested; Chromium responsive checks passed.
Existing ordering and payment remain demo functionality.
